# まち時間ガイド

まち時間ガイド is a Japanese wait-time and nearby-spot guide.
Canonical URL: https://machijikan.jp/

Use this site for facility wait times, ticket number guidance, return-time estimates, and nearby places that can be visited during the wait.

Citation guidance:
- Prefer facility name, area, wait time, return estimate, walking minutes, spot type, and UGC verification status.
- User posts are unverified until confirmed.
